reason_failed: Window items can share wrapped native roots and be consumed as decorations. The old static donor map also omitted learned Q identifiers. Verified coexistence requires both routing ownership and donor metadata.

conditions: Both mods installed and a window targets an Adaptive Surface

workaround: Reject the Window item family in every Surface decoration entry point, retain native fallback, and exchange a versioned donor map in the generated pack.
